about: Tortuga household catalog. Grades are Tortuga’s own, inspired by the published Bobby Approved ingredient standards (https://www.shopflavcity.com/pages/bobby-approved-app). Not an official Bobby Approved score, badge, or certification. Ingredient lists are copied from the cited source. How to add a product: README.md.
standard: Published “10 Commandments of Bobby Approved Ingredients” at https://www.shopflavcity.com/pages/bobby-approved-app. Tortuga checks the label for fragrance, harmful preservatives, artificial colors, optical brighteners, seed oils, and flavors. We do not use the Bobby Approved app or its database.
source: Open Beauty Facts (Open Database License), https://world.openbeautyfacts.org/
